leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct type guard functions to validate API response structures
Apply type predicates to narrow unknown types to specific interfaces
Implement runtime checks for required properties in dynamic data
Configure type guards to handle nested object structures
Integrate type guards with fetch operations to ensure type safety
Manipulate unknown data by applying successive validation layers
Initialize type-safe variables from validated API payloads
lessonTitle: Build type guards for unknown API payloads
